$comment: Which builder weapons really deal a second damage type, checked against fallout.wiki on 2026-09-28 for every WEAPON_COMBAT_BASE_CATALOG row that carried `secondaryDamage` (combat-firepower-catalog.ts). `printed` is the infobox damage as the page prints it (icon labels written as words, per-level values left to right, highest level last); `components` is the highest-level row; `catalog` is the row's values at the time of the check. `verdict`: split-verified = the page prints two damage lines, so the catalog's baseDamage is one component and the secondary stays; secondary-mod-only = the page prints one base line and the second type comes from a mod, so the secondary is dropped; unverified = the page prints no figure, so the secondary is off until a source appears. Component VALUES are not settled here: where they differ from the catalog the note says 'wider audit' (Agent_Exchange/ROLL_WEAPON_STATS_AUDIT_2026-09-28.md) and Nathan decides which numbers move. Nothing is estimated. weapon-stats-wiki.test.ts pins the catalog to these verdicts.

splitDamage.quote: many weapons are able to deal multiple Damage Types per attack, such as the Shishkebab which deals both Physical and Fire Damage.

meleeStrengthDisplay.quote: the damage bonus from Strength is not reflected on the PipBoy for any non-Physical Damage on melee weapons.

cold-shoulder.label: Cold Shoulder (Double-Barrel · Unique)
cold-shoulder.note: Two infobox damage lines, equal halves scaling per level. The catalog's 115 / 75 matches no printed tier: wider audit.

v63-zweihander.label: V63 Zweihänder (Super Sledge · Unique)
v63-zweihander.printed: Physical Damage 150 / 191 / 244; Energy Damage 64; Physical Damage +5% × STR
v63-zweihander.note: Energy is a flat 64 at every tier while physical scales. The catalog's 125 / 40 matches no printed tier: wider audit.

v63-shock-baton.label: V63 Shock Baton (Security Baton · Unique)
v63-shock-baton.printed: Damage: [Physical Damage icon] (no figure); Physical Damage +% × STR (placeholder)
v63-shock-baton.note: The page prints no damage figure and names only physical damage; no energy or electrical damage is stated anywhere. The catalog's 30 energy secondary has no source, so it is off.

the-kabloom.label: The Kabloom (Pump Shotgun · Unique)
the-kabloom.note: The page prints '?' for damage and never mentions poison (damage types on the page: physical, ballistic, explosive; 8 projectiles). The catalog's 40 poison secondary has no source, so it is off.

radium-rifle.label: Radium Rifle
radium-rifle.note: Two infobox damage lines (only two tiers printed). The catalog's 38 / 15 matches neither: wider audit.

cremator.label: Cremator
cremator.printed: Fire Damage 86 / 110 / 150; burn 20 / 25 / 32 Fire Damage per second for 6 seconds
cremator.maxLevelRow: Level 50: 150 fire impact + 32 fire per second × 6 s burn
cremator.note: Impact plus burn-over-time, both fire, as the engine models it. The catalog's 140 is a burn total (wiki 32 × 6 = 192 at level 50) and its 80 impact vs the printed 150: wider audit. Golden weapon, values untouched.

gatling-plasma.label: Gatling Plasma
gatling-plasma.note: Two equal infobox lines; the page notes the physical half follows energy resistance rules. The catalog's 58 / 58 vs the printed 28 / 28: wider audit.

plasma-caster.label: Plasma Caster
plasma-caster.note: Two equal infobox lines. The catalog's 76 / 76 vs the printed 103 / 103: wider audit.

gauss-minigun.label: Gauss Minigun
gauss-minigun.printed: Physical Damage 52 / 59; mods: Prime capacitor +13 Energy Damage, Tesla capacitor +6 Energy Damage, Tesla dynamo +3 Energy Damage
gauss-minigun.note: The base weapon prints one physical line; energy exists only with the Prime / Tesla capacitor mods. Secondary dropped. The catalog's energy primary type and 45 vs 59: wider audit.

enclave-plasma.label: Enclave Plasma Gun
enclave-plasma.note: Two equal infobox lines. The catalog's 48 / 48 vs the printed 57 / 57: wider audit.

enclave-plasma-rifle.label: Enclave Plasma Rifle
enclave-plasma-rifle.note: Alias of the Enclave Plasma Gun page.

plasma-gun.label: Plasma Gun
plasma-gun.note: The catalog equals the printed level-45 halves exactly: baseDamage is the ballistic half, not a total, so adding the energy half does not double-count.

plasma-flamer.label: Plasma Flamer
plasma-flamer.note: Plasma Gun with the flamer barrel; the split is the chassis's. The mods table's flamer barrel row could not be read cleanly ('+30' in one column), so the catalog's 45 / 45 is unchecked: wider audit.

gamma-gun.label: Gamma Gun
gamma-gun.printed: Damage: Physical Damage 56 / 71 / 90 / 115; Area Damage: Radiation Damage 50; mods: Standard dish +50 Radiation Damage (baseline), Deep dish +125 Radiation Damage, Electric Signal Carrier Antennae +40 Energy Damage
gamma-gun.note: Energy exists only with the antennae muzzle mod: secondary dropped. The printed structure (115 physical + 50 radiation area from the default dish) differs from the catalog's 110 radiation primary: wider audit.

plasma-cutter.label: Plasma Cutter
plasma-cutter.printed: Physical Damage 70 / 87 / 109; Physical Damage +5% × STR; Energy Damage 70 / 87 / 109
plasma-cutter.note: Two equal infobox lines (the '(Fallout_76)' URL 404s). The catalog's 50 / 35 vs the printed 109 / 109: wider audit.

shishkebab.label: Shishkebab
shishkebab.printed: Physical Damage 50 / 64; Fire Damage 50 / 64; Physical Damage +5% × STR
shishkebab.note: Two infobox lines; Damage_(Fallout_76) names it as the split-damage example. The catalog's 45 / 30 vs the printed 64 / 64: wider audit.

cattleprod.label: Cattle Prod
cattleprod.note: Two equal infobox lines across ten tiers (wiki title is one word, 'Cattleprod'). The catalog's 42 / 25 vs the printed 84 / 84: wider audit.
